title: queryChanges ignores filter/view/default sort
description: From batch-5 verify (ji1v, y3f2.1, y3f2.7). RFC 8620 §5.6: /queryChanges reports changes to the results of the same query. (1) tasks-server MemoryBackend::query_changes ignores the new taskListId filter that query_objects honours; its rustdoc premise is now false. (2) chat-server MemoryBackend::query_changes ignores the view filter (Message) and the non-member hiding (Space) that query_objects now applies, so it can announce ids /query and /get hide. (3) the chat /query handlers now pass the draft default sort but the /queryChanges handlers do not. Fix: apply the same filter/visibility/sort in query_changes, or return cannotCalculateChanges when it cannot.
close_reason: Landed in 7d522090 fix(chat,tasks)!: queryChanges honours the query (batch 6, adversarially verified, CI green at a586c251)
